section1.description: To introduce authentic Japanese desserts in UAE by turning a timeless choux pastry into a new kind of sensory joy — crispy cream-filled desserts with an audible golden crunch outside, and chilled smooth cream inside.

section2.description: We take inspiration from classic Japanese patisserie traditions and elevate them with modern textures and vibrant global flavours. Every TUMU dessert stick is freshly baked on-site, filled to order with premium Japanese cream desserts, and delivered warm and crisp directly to your hands.

section3.heading: JAPAN!
section3.description: Rooted in Japanese craftsmanship and uncompromising attention to detail, TUMU brings the soul of Japan's pastry culture to the UAE. Visit our Japanese dessert shop Dubai locations to taste the magic firsthand.

hero.description: The secret behind the finest crispy cream-filled desserts and Japanese desserts in UAE: an obsession with texture, temperature contrast, and zero compromise on fresh ingredients.

steps.title: BAKE
steps.subtitle: Golden Convection Baking
steps.description: Every pastry stick starts as pure choux dough made with Japanese flour and unbleached butter. Baked fresh in specialized convection ovens at controlled temperature to form a hollow, airy chamber.

steps.title: CRUNCH
steps.subtitle: Almond & Pearl Sugar Crust
steps.description: Before baking, each stick is coated with our secret crust layer of toasted crushed almonds and pearl sugar. This delivers our hallmark crispy cream-filled dessert experience.

steps.title: FILL
steps.subtitle: Chilled Cream Piped to Order
steps.description: To ensure zero sogginess, our authentic Japanese cream desserts are never pre-filled. When you order, chilled silky cream is injected from end to end using high-precision confectionery nozzles.

steps.title: FINISH
steps.subtitle: Artisanal Garnishing
steps.description: Delicate finishing touches — whether ceremonial Uji matcha dusting, roasted pistachio crumbles, or cocoa dust — applied with pastry chef precision.

steps.title: SERVE
steps.subtitle: Peak Temperature Contrast
steps.description: Served within seconds of filling. That breathtaking first bite captures the legendary sensory contrast: warm, flaky exterior married with cool, luxurious Japanese cream.
